note: Regression for hif-backend#47. HIF has no repeat, so `repeat (3) @(posedge clk)` is lowered to a for loop over an index hif2verilog declares and initialises itself; getting that wrong leaves a legal loop that runs the wrong number of times. Behavioral because the wrong count is valid Verilog - the observable is the pulse period, four clocks here, which is the repeat count plus the release edge. The accumulating pulse counter keeps a period that drifted rather than changed outright from matching.
